review.scope: Selected primary methods, theory and evaluation sections; recent author-report evidence checked against selected released artifacts. Not an exhaustive review, every-page review, independent reproduction, or complete code audit.
review.retrieval: Versioned PDFs from arXiv, author HTML, and commit-pinned GitHub raw artifacts; browser retrieval returned empty results, so direct HTTPS retrieval supplied the inspected source bytes.
review.citation_policy: Reference IDs and physical PDF page locators in research.md resolve to sources below. ArXiv version dates describe the reviewed version, not necessarily a later journal publication. No claim that each selected version is the latest version of the work.

sources.title: Equivariant Architectures for Learning in Deep Weight Spaces

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Constructs layers equivariant to hidden-neuron permutations and evaluates weight-space prediction and editing.
sources.limitation: Function preservation requires consistent incoming/outgoing permutations and biases; generalization of a learned editor is empirical.

sources.title: Permutation Equivariant Neural Functionals

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Develops permutation-equivariant neural functionals for processing neural parameters.
sources.limitation: The full NP symmetry includes input/output permutations; those are not hidden-unit function symmetries when feature and label meanings are fixed.

sources.title: Universal Neural Functionals

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Uses computation-graph information to build neural functionals across parameter structures.
sources.limitation: The paper distinguishes unwanted spatial filter permutations from function-preserving symmetries; universality is not behavioral correctness.

sources.title: Graph Metanetworks for Processing Diverse Neural Architectures

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Represents diverse neural architectures as parameter graphs processed by metanetworks.
sources.limitation: Graph representation support does not imply a verifier for every represented operator or architecture.

sources.title: Scale Equivariant Graph Metanetworks

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Accounts for activation-dependent permutation, positive-scale, and sign symmetries.
sources.limitation: ReLU scaling must be positive and transform the bias and outgoing weights; tanh/sine sign symmetries have different assumptions.

sources.title: Equivariant Deep Weight Space Alignment

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Learns equivariant alignment of neural network weights.
sources.limitation: Optimal-alignment equivariance needs uniqueness or set-valued treatment; perfect recovery has activation and genericity assumptions.

sources.title: Git Re-Basin: Merging Models modulo Permutation Symmetries

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Aligns hidden permutations before merging independently trained models; gives multilayer weight-matching heuristics.
sources.limitation: Applying a permutation is exactly function preserving; interpolation quality is empirical, coordinate descent is heuristic, and the paper does not establish a zero-barrier ImageNet result.

sources.title: HyperNetworks

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Trains networks that generate another network's parameters.
sources.limitation: Generator training uses gradient-based optimization; generating weights does not certify their behavior.

sources.title: HyperDiffusion: Generating Implicit Neural Fields with Weight-Space Diffusion

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Trains diffusion over weights of fitted implicit neural fields.
sources.limitation: The fitted-field corpus and diffusion model incur training costs and restrict the demonstrated distribution.

sources.title: Towards Scalable and Versatile Weight Space Learning

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Uses sequence-based weight representations and autoencoding for scalable weight-space learning and generation.
sources.limitation: A scalable representation does not remove lineage leakage, reconstruction controls, or generator-training costs.

sources.title: Generative Modeling of Weights: Generalization or Memorization?

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Studies memorization and generalization of generative weight models with empirical controls.
sources.limitation: Findings motivate strong baselines and lineage-aware splits; they are not a universal impossibility theorem for useful weight generation.

sources.title: Drag-and-Drop LLMs: Zero-Shot Prompt-to-Weights

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Learns a mapping from prompts to adaptation weights and evaluates zero-shot target-time generation.
sources.limitation: The generator is trained using prompt/LoRA checkpoint pairs; zero-shot at inference does not mean no gradient training or no task-specific provenance.

sources.title: Weight-Space Linear Recurrent Neural Networks

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Models recurrent weight dynamics using a linear recurrence driven by input differences.
sources.limitation: Evidence concerns learned dynamic models, not guaranteed semantic correctness of arbitrary static edits.

sources.title: Model soups: averaging weights of multiple fine-tuned models improves accuracy without increasing inference time

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Averages fine-tuned model weights and evaluates accuracy without ensemble inference cost.
sources.limitation: Results rely on model compatibility, shared pretraining and validation/selection choices.

sources.title: Editing Models with Task Arithmetic

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Uses fine-tuning differences as task vectors for addition, negation and analogy experiments.
sources.limitation: Vector algebra does not itself establish independent or compositional task semantics.

sources.title: TIES-Merging: Resolving Interference When Merging Models

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Reduces merging interference through trimming, sign election and disjoint merging.
sources.limitation: Conflict handling is empirically evaluated; it is not a proof that merged behavior meets independent task contracts.

sources.title: Task Arithmetic in the Tangent Space: Improved Editing of Pre-Trained Models

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Studies task arithmetic via linearization and task-support/disentanglement conditions.
sources.limitation: Theoretical conditions are explicit; ordinary nonlinear fine-tuning need not satisfy the linearized setting.

sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Trains low-rank parameter updates with a frozen base model.
sources.limitation: Low rank bounds a representation dimension, not output drift, locality, or successful task transfer.

sources.title: Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Derives a constrained rank-one update for a linear associative-memory component and evaluates factual editing.
sources.limitation: Covariance/key estimates and end-to-end locality are empirical; a local layer equation is not preservation of all model knowledge.

sources.title: AlphaEdit: Null-Space Constrained Knowledge Editing for Language Models

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Constrains edit directions using the nullspace of preserved keys.
sources.limitation: Exact protection applies to specified keys with delta K0 = 0; the practical 1e-2 eigenvalue cutoff yields approximate nullspaces, and sampled keys do not cover all knowledge.

sources.title: Reluplex: An Efficient SMT Solver for Verifying Deep Neural Networks

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Presents a sound and complete abstract decision procedure for the stated piecewise-linear verification problem.
sources.limitation: PDF page 12 explicitly states that floating-point tableau restoration in the implementation does not guarantee soundness.

sources.title: Efficient Neural Network Robustness Certification with General Activation Functions

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Derives certified output bounds using valid local affine envelopes of activation functions on a specified input domain.
sources.limitation: Bound validity depends on those envelopes and domain assumptions; failure to certify can reflect loose bounds rather than an actual violation.

sources.title: Provable Repair of Deep Neural Networks

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Decouples activation and value computations so repair of a single value layer becomes linear constraints.
sources.limitation: The architecture is changed to a decoupled network; polytope repair uses activation-region vertices, whose number can be exponential.

sources.title: TorchLean: Formalizing Neural Networks in Lean

reviewed_locator.scope: selected methods, theoretical claims and/or evaluation sections, not an every-page review

sources.finding: Formalizes shared SSA/DAG semantics, differentiation, robustness analysis and certificate checking in Lean.
sources.limitation: Table 3 limits the proved operator/compiler coverage; finite-path IEEE32Exec refinement is internal and is not a proof of deployed CPU/CUDA floating-point execution.

sources.title: A Survey of Weight Space Learning: Understanding, Representation, and Generation

reviewed_locator.scope: abstract and top-level understanding/representation/generation taxonomy; used for discovery, not as primary experimental evidence

sources.title: Awesome Weight Space Learning

reviewed_locator.scope: taxonomy, source links and selection of primary work

sources.limitation: Pinned supplied index is a discovery aid, not evidence that a listed method works or an exhaustive snapshot of later work.
